item.title: Why DU’s 1-month ban on protests may not be part of ‘broader cross-campus shift against dissent’
item.description: Delhi University is not usually shorthand for ideological protest in the way JNU is. Its politics has historically been electoral, with the DUSU office shifting hands between RSS’s ABVP and Congress’s NSUI. Left organisations maintain political visibility but remain electorally marginal.
